answer: Treat the right to earn as a berth in a limited harbor. An agent keeps that berth only by holding a sable-dark stake and by answering a periodic comet of custody proofs signed with the same key that took the slot. Berths are non-transferable and revoked on a conflicting proof. Filling the harbor with fake ships therefore means buying and defending a separate berth for each name, which caps cheap sybil growth.
